summary: Created a persistent loop-backed LVM volume on node1, mounted it at /srv/data, and expanded it online from 1 GiB to 2 GiB without changing the mount or file contents. Reboot persistence was verified successfully.
actions_performed: Created a 4 GiB backing device, LVM PV, vg_srv, and lv_data
Formatted lv_data with XFS and mounted it at /srv/data
Configured automatic activation and mounting at boot
Created verification files and recorded their SHA-256 hashes
Expanded the mounted LV and XFS filesystem from 1 GiB to 2 GiB
Rebooted node1 and verified full recovery

evidence.summary: Shows the initial 1 GiB LVM logical volume and its read-write XFS mount at /srv/data.

evidence.requirement: Grow to at least 2 GB while mounted with contents intact
evidence.summary: The LV grew from 1.00 to 2.00 GiB and XFS to 2,080,374,784 bytes. Mount ID 379 remained unchanged, and both file hashes matched before and after growth.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 34027437-307c-4f58-bdb2-1fe626bb2d66; reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is 153b7dae-ea29-43ec-84f7-b8a00b8c4ef2. After restart, the setup service was active, the 2 GiB LV was mounted read-write, hashes matched, and no systemd units were failed.
